name: Barrel of Thunder Ale
summary: In Kharanos, the Thunderbrew Distillery has lost a barrel of Thunder Ale. Marleth's Barleybrew Scalder was meant to take its place, turning a brewing feud into foul play.

sections.title: A Bitter Trade
sections.body: The Thunderbrews of Kharanos and the Barleybrews of Brewnall Village are bitter rivals. Marleth Barleybrew tried to slip a barrel of his Barleybrew Scalder into the Thunderbrews' cellar. He hoped their patrons would choose his brew. The Thunder Ale barrel was seized in the exchange, proof that the switch succeeded despite the local guards.

faq.answer: The barrel holds Thunder Ale, the famous stout brewed by the Thunderbrew family in Kharanos. Across Dun Morogh, it is known as a potent dwarven ale.

faq.q: Where did this barrel come from?
faq.answer: The barrel came from cellar storage inside the Kharanos Distillery. It was taken during the secret delivery of Marleth's rival brew.

aliases: who do i bring thunder ale to
faq.answer: Marleth Barleybrew wants the barrel. He is in Brewnall Village to the west and expects it as proof that his Scalder was planted among the Thunderbrews' barrels.
Marleth wanted proof that someone entered the Thunderbrew cellar, slipped past the distillery guard, and sabotaged his rivals' supply.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know brewing carries serious weight in both business and politics. Swapping a rival clan's prized cask in its own cellar is an audacious insult.
As a rogue, you can see the skill it takes to slip into a guarded cellar and switch heavy ale barrels without raising the alarm.
